# holyfloe

> holyfloe generates typed React (18, 19), Vue 3 and Svelte 5 wrapper components for Lit web components. It reads Lit source directly (`--lit`, via oxc) or a Custom Elements Manifest (`--cem`), and writes one wrapper per element. It's a Rust engine shipped as a CLI binary, an npm package with a Node API (`@holyfloe/core`) and a bundler plugin (`@holyfloe/unplugin`).

Facts an assistant should get right:

- Packages: `@holyfloe/core` (Node API: `generate`, `watch`, `version`; analyzer plugin at `@holyfloe/core/cem-plugin`) and `@holyfloe/unplugin` (`holyfloe.vite(...)`, also `.rollup`, `.webpack`, `.rspack`, `.esbuild`, `.rolldown`; only Vite is tested). CLI binary: `holyfloe`.
- CLI: `holyfloe generate (--lit <dir> | --cem <custom-elements.json>) --out <dir> --frameworks react,vue,svelte [--config holyfloe.config.json] [--react-mode wrapper|types] [--watch]`. Exactly one of `--lit` and `--cem`.
- Node and plugin options mirror the CLI: `{ lit | cem, out, frameworks, config?, reactMode? }`, with exactly one of `lit` and `cem`.
- Output goes to `<out>/react/`, `<out>/vue/`, `<out>/svelte/`: one file per element (`FxButton.tsx`, `FxButton.ts`, `FxButton.svelte`), an `index.ts`, a shared `react-utils.ts`/`vue-utils.ts`/`svelte-utils.ts`, and types for the plain tags (`global-components.d.ts` for Vue, `svelte-elements.d.ts` for Svelte). Only files whose content changed are written; nothing is deleted.
- Component names are PascalCase of the tag (`fx-button` gives `FxButton`). Each event gets a PascalCase base name (`open-change` gives `OpenChange`): the React and Svelte prop is `onOpenChange`, and the Vue wrapper emits `OpenChange`, listened to with `@open-change` or `onOpenChange`.
- Types are never resolved: props are typed `Element['prop']` from an `import type` of the element class, and event details come from `CustomEvent<T>`. The package's `package.json` `exports` decides import paths; use config `moduleRewrite` (e.g. `{ "src/": "dist/" }`) when source paths differ from published ones. Error E002 means a module matched no `exports` entry.
- Two-way binding: Vue `v-model:<prop>` and Svelte `bind:<prop>`, inferred for `value`, `checked`, `open` and `selected`, or declared with JSDoc `@model <prop> <event> [detail.<field>|target.<prop>]` or config `overrides.<tag>.bindings`. React gets no binding helper.
- SSR: string, number and boolean props render as attributes; objects, arrays and functions are set as properties on the client. React wrappers include `'use client'`. Next.js needs `"moduleResolution": "nodenext"`, because wrappers import each other with `.js` paths.
- JSDoc tags read: `@fires`/`@event {CustomEvent<T>} name - text`, `@slot [name] - text`, `@csspart`/`@part`, `@cssprop`/`@cssproperty`, `@cssstate`, `@model`, `@deprecated`, `@internal`, `@private`, `@protected`, `@tag`, `@summary`.
- Error codes: E002 module not exported, E003 inheritance cycle, E004 duplicate tag, E005 duplicate prop, E006 events that map to the same prop name (rename with `overrides.<tag>.events`), E007 empty event name, E008 invalid tag or name, E009 override for something that does not exist, E010 unsupported config key, E012 detail type import clash, E013 prop clashes with a generated name (exclude it with `overrides.<tag>.excludeProps`), E014 component names equal ignoring case, E015 invalid binding.

## Docs

- [Docs site](https://mohamadadithya.github.io/holyfloe/): the user guide (getting started, CLI, bundler plugin, Node API, frameworks, configuration, error codes); sources in `site/src/content/docs/`
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/README.md): install, usage in each framework, CLI, Vite plugin, Node API, configuration, JSDoc tags, known limits
- [@holyfloe/core README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/packages/core/README.md): Node API and the CEM analyzer plugin
- [@holyfloe/unplugin README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/packages/unplugin/README.md): bundler plugin options and behaviour
- [IR and configuration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/docs/ir.md): every `holyfloe.config.json` key, module resolution, binding inference rules, the error code table
- [React output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/docs/emit-react.md): wrapper and types modes, refs, events, SSR handling
- [Vue output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/docs/emit-vue.md): `defineComponent` wrappers, `v-model`, slots
- [Svelte output](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/docs/emit-svelte.md): Svelte 5 components, snippets for slots, `bind:`
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Examples

- [Fixture components](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamadadithya/holyfloe/main/fixtures/README.md): the 12 Lit components used as the spec, and what each covers
